Name: Guardian Pylons replace Obelisks
Author: notomention
Description:
Changes the existing obelisks on Earth, Water, Desert, and Island, Farm with Guardian Pylons.
Requires smapi and Content Patcher



How to install :
1. install smapi
2. install Content patcher
3. Open the .zip file
4. Paste in /Mod folder
5. Finish!

There are 3 packs be sure to pick ONE only! or else there will be conflicts

V1.3:  now the new versions have all of the other Pylon from other singular mods, now you don't need to replace them manually anymore
thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]  for helping me with the codes

V1.2 Some minor art touch-up + NSEW version.

Add option mod for " East Scarp" Obelisk, how to install: ( thanks vashta33 for the suggestion)
- get the east scarp mod + requiement 
- download the new obelisk in the option files
- extract
- copy the folder inside the extract ( it should be the [CP] East Scarp folder)
- open the "East scarp" folder in the mod folder
- Paste
- agree to replace
- done
